terms.label: Open Intelligence
terms.definition: An approach to open, interoperable, and verifiable intelligence systems in which models, agents, tools, knowledge, computing resources, and human expertise can be discovered, evaluated, communicate, reason, coordinate, and contribute to shared objectives.

terms.label: OI Resource
terms.definition: A discoverable participant or asset, such as a model, agent, tool, dataset, skill, compute resource, or human expertise offering.

terms.label: OI System
terms.definition: A system that consumes, provides, coordinates, or evaluates OI resources.

terms.label: OI Network
terms.definition: A set of OI systems and resources connected through defined interfaces and policies.

terms.label: OI Fabric
terms.definition: The interoperability foundation defining shared terminology, resource contracts, discovery conventions, and compatibility rules.

terms.label: OI Swarm
terms.definition: A coordinated population of distributed OI resources operating under an explicit objective and policy boundary.

terms.label: Federated Heterogeneous Mixture of Experts
terms.definition: A system-level approach that selects and composes independently implemented heterogeneous experts, including models, agents, tools, datasets, and human expertise.

terms.label: OI Conformance
terms.definition: Evidence that an implementation satisfies a specified version of an interface, schema, or behavioral requirement.
